starbridge ask --question "Use Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip for web app error tracking?" --context "Sentry: free up to 5k errors/month, then \$26/month; session replay included; no maintenance.
GlitchTip: free, runs on our VPS, but we patch and back it up ourselves (~1 hour/month).

turns.final:
I've posted the Sentry vs. GlitchTip question to you through Starbridge (card `d_uJeExkB5cpH5fJKV`) and haven't wired in any error tracking yet.

You asked for AskUserQuestion, but that prompt came back saying you're away from the terminal and to ask through Starbridge instead, so I did.

The card lays out both options from NOTES.md. Sentry is free up to 5k errors a month, then $26/month, with session replay included. GlitchTip is free but needs about an hour a month of patching and backups. I listed Sentry first as the recommendation, because it needs no maintenance.

Your answer will arrive here as a new prompt, and I'll wire in whichever service you pick then.

decisions.question: Use Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip for web app error tracking?
